commits.subject: P-cluster: linear-equivalence invariance of the adelic chi-ledger
commits.summary:
**New file** `RiemannRoch/Adelic/ClassInvariance.lean` (sorry-free, axiom-clean). Multiplication by $g \in K(X)^\times$ is a $k$-linear automorphism of $K(X)$ carrying $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O(D))$ ONTO $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O(D-\mathrm{div}\,g))$, and it carries the coboundary $B(D)$ onto $B(D-\mathrm{div}\,g)$, so it descends to $\check H^1(D)\cong\check H^1(D-\mathrm{div}\,g)$.

**Consequence.** $\ell$, $h^1$ and $\chi$ are invariants of the linear-equivalence class: `ell_eq_of_linearEquivalence`, `h1dim_eq_of_linearEquivalence`, `chi_eq_of_linearEquivalence`. UNCONDITIONAL — no gate, no finiteness input, no ledger-exactness hypothesis, unlike the chi-additivity theorems it complements.

**Effective-witness dictionary.** `exists_effective_linearEquiv_of_ne_zero_mem`: a nonzero $f\in L(D)$ exhibits $D+\mathrm{div}\,f\ge 0$ in the class of $D$; `one_le_ell_of_nonneg` is the converse $\ell\ge1$. This is the peel-an-effective-divisor input of uniform $H^1$ vanishing.

**Provenance:** ADAPTED ARGUMENT, not a port. The sibling AJCR proves the same mathematics sheaf-theoretically (`mulEquivDivisorSheaf`, `chi_divisorSheaf_eq_of_picClass_eq`) on a `CurveDivisor`/`divisorSheaf`/`CechPic` substrate that does not exist in AJC. Rederived in the adelic function-field abstractions; no AJCR code copied.
